# SF Headless Page Check

> Verifies Salesforce pages headlessly through clickpath assertions and their visible text, signed in through the SF CLI.

**What it does.** Drives the sfqa CLI against a Salesforce org, asserts each clickpath step and records each page's text. It writes text evidence only and keeps credentials out of the transcript.

**Not for.** Do not trigger for interactive browser exploration (use sf-browser-automation) or for non-Salesforce pages.
